subject: A San Antonio option for your Eating Disorders links
body:
Hi Mayra,

Thank you for being on our referral newsletter list. Your Mental Health Links page has an Eating Disorders section, and disordered eating is one of the specialties your team lists.

At the Bariatric Counseling Center, we offer an Intensive Outpatient Program for people who struggle with binge eating and chronic over-eating. We provide group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education in one program. Clients attend onsite in San Antonio or by Zoom, and we accept most health insurances.

Would you consider adding us to the Eating Disorders section at https://vitalitylifecounselingsa.com/mental-health-links? The link could go to https://www.bariatriccounselingcenter.com/ourprogram/ with the text "Bariatric Counseling Center (binge eating and over-eating program)".

Thank you,
Todd McCord
Bariatric Counseling Center of San Antonio
210.634.2200
